status: Exploratory fit-adequacy follow-up, specified after inspecting the original 512-document test; the original study is retained unchanged
motivation: All three full-vocabulary CE fits selected their shared ridge initialization. Do not describe identical selected models as three independent replications or infer intrinsic nonlinearity from finite-budget fitting.

methods.free_lower_lr: Original unrestricted affine vocabulary head, learning rate 1e-5, seeds17/29/43
methods.tied_affine: Four affine latent-to-native-feature maps with the released unembedding fixed; same representational initialization, CE learning rates1e-5,3e-5,1e-4; seeds17/29/43

fit: 2048 updates,64chunks,beta defaults of AdamW,weight_decay0.01; maximize original256-document validation agreement at0/512/1024/2048, earliest tie. Tied initialization is recovered by least squares from the existing ridge effective weights; record reconstruction error.
selection: Select one tied learning rate by mean validation agreement over three runs, earliest listed tie. Retain all learning curves and checkpoints. Original test is not used for this selection.
fresh_test: The next512eligible documents in exactly the original seeded permutation, after the original4864. Assert the first4864document hashes reproduce the existing cohort. Freeze selected weights before encoding/decoding the new test.
primary_followup: Paired posterior-state native-agreement gain of selected tied affine vs original ridge, averaged across three fits,4000document-bootstrap draws,seed61102209; report all three runs and native-reference reconstruction
limits: One autoencoder,one corpus; probe improvement rather than generator/task-quality gain; no test-based sample-size or method changes. Native parameter sharing and initialization are explicit priors.
